name: audio_pitch_harmonics
expr: f220 = pitch(x220, fs); f100 = pitch(x100, fs); h220 = harmonicRatio(x220, fs); pn220 = numel(f220); hn220 = numel(h220); f220_first = f220(1); f220_mean = mean(f220); f100_mean = mean(f100); h220_mean = mean(h220); fcep220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'CEP'); cep_first = fcep220(1); cep_2 = fcep220(2); cep_4 = fcep220(4); cep_mean = mean(fcep220);
comment: MATLAB Audio Toolbox cycles E + F + K: pitch + harmonicRatio. pitch via NCF (Normalized Cross-correlation Function) — default method per MATLAB R2025b. Defaults match MATLAB: WindowLength=round(0.052*fs)=832 samples for fs=16000, OverlapLength=round(0.042*fs)=672, hop=160, Range=[50,400] Hz. harmonicRatio uses 30/20ms windows. Frame counts (95 for pitch, 98 for harmonicRatio at 16001 samples) match MATLAB exactly. f0 NCF within ~1% of true frequency (220→220.45, 100→101.04 vs MATLAB 219.18, 100.63). Cycle F: harmonicRatio gained MATLAB R2025b parity (auto low-edge + Smith parabolic refinement). Cycle K: pitch supports Method='CEP' (Cepstrum, Noll 1967) — bit-equal MATLAB R2025b audio.internal.pitch.CEP.m via batched FFT (NFFT=2^nextpow2(2*winLen-1)) + log|fft|² + ifft. KNOWN GAPs: pitch methods 'PEF'/'LHS'/'SRH' still deferred (NCF + CEP shipped); pitchnn deferred (needs DNN runtime). Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship pitch or harmonicRatio in core. Tolerance 5% for parity (algorithmic equivalence rather than bit-equality for NCF; CEP is bit-equal).
